# Verify email form open redirect validation (2026-02-01 11:24Z)

_**User**_

In `@components/verify-email-form.tsx` around lines 125 - 129, The code currently  
uses the user-controlled next query value directly when building confirmUrl and  
later calling router.push, enabling open redirects; update the logic in the  
verify-email-form component to validate and normalize next before using it:  
ensure next is either an absolute same-origin URL or (preferably) a relative  
path beginning with "/" and not containing protocol/host, otherwise ignore it  
(or default to "/"); apply this validation where you set  
confirmUrl.searchParams.set("next", next) and where router.push(next) is called  
so external domains are rejected and only safe same-origin relative paths are  
used.
